purposes.0001-integration-build-hook.patch: Attach the integration targets to the official engine build with its configured dependencies.
purposes.0002-houdini-usd-link-libraries.patch: Supply the Houdini USD 26.05 HD/SI and MaterialX link dependencies required by the pinned delegate.
purposes.0003-point-nonuniform-normals.patch: Correct transformed point-sphere normals. Nonuniform object scale creates an ellipsoid, whose world-space normal requires the inverse transpose of its object-space normal.
purposes.0004-volume-shutter-and-bounds.patch: Carry the native volume's actual normalized shutter reference and conservative velocity envelope through volume meshing and shading. Preserve upstream defaults for other adapters.
purposes.0005-point-lifetime-intersections.patch: Add per-point existence intervals to CPU/custom GPU intersections and Embree filters. Read stationary OptiX ray time from the original Cycles ray payload.
purposes.0006-opt-in-phase-diagnostics.patch: Allow quiet, accumulated engine update statistics, add a complete scene-update timer and expose an optional logical buffer-copy callback. Existing default reporting remains unchanged.
purposes.0007-retain-clean-shader-buffers.patch: Clear shader/SVM buffer modified flags after successful delivery; retain pending flags on a device error. Actual shader rebuilds still mark buffers dirty.
purposes.0008-bounded-subdivision.patch: Add optional post-tessellation seam/metric publication, per-mesh triangle guards and cancellation checks in splitting/dicing/interpolation. Upstream consumers retain unlimited budgets unless explicitly configured.
purposes.0009-smooth-subdivision-color.patch: Read float3 face-varying values with packed storage and enable the existing smooth evaluator for packed float3.
purposes.0010-texture-resource-revisions.patch: Include owned resource revisions in image identity and numeric internal sockets in shader/displacement identity; isolate derived cache lookup by revision/configuration; propagate image-load failures to render progress. Unconfigured upstream resources retain the default cache lookup.
purposes.0011-frozen-color-configuration.patch: Add an opt-in immutable engine OCIO configuration and complete processor/name/XYZ/interop cache reset without changing the host global config.
purposes.0012-portable-color-identity.patch: Accept the embedding host's established working ID for derived caches, including unknown/local identities; remove obsolete source primaries and ACES-container flags after conversion.
purposes.0013-texture-coverage-alpha.patch: Process RGB while preserving texture coverage through arbitrary OCIO transforms, and invalidate derivatives produced by the earlier alpha-changing route.
purposes.0078-spectral-nested-medium-ior-and-53-k: Store absolute wavelength-dependent medium IORs through camera, SSS and MNEE probes before forming interface ratios; preserve shared CPU/GPU spectral weights and adapt Quaternion attribute/shadow result types to Blender 5.3.
purposes.0077-houdini-dlss-project.patch: Initialize the independent Houdini native DLSS project and retain per-session NGX runtime identity without Blender session dependencies.
purposes.0079-dlss-history-epoch.patch: Reset DLSS temporal state through a per-session epoch consumed by the render thread at the next successful evaluation after a hard scene edit.
purposes.0080-blender53-native-attribute-and-tess: Use explicit indices for the Blender 5.3 attribute-buffer enum class and retain subdivision reuse with the corrected tessellation API spelling.
purposes.0081-gsplat-retained-attribute-copies.pa: Repopulate unchanged quaternion and packed SH attributes whenever the shared buffer is reallocated or its layout changes, preserving Gaussian radiance and orientation during object insertion/removal without forcing unrelated geometry conversion.
purposes.0082-hosted-ipr-gpu-state-budget.patch: Keep hosted interactive GPU integrator states at normal device concurrency by default while preserving low-memory shrink, explicit environment overrides and upstream/final growth; carry policy per session and each physical render device.
purposes.0083-full-precision-light-pass-weights.p: Preserve full float RGB diffuse/glossy light-pass fractions in main and shadow GPU state so independent half rounding cannot leak non-transmitting reflection into an unreconstructable transmission remainder; retain the remaining compact state and Beauty estimator.
purposes.0084-gsplat-point-lifetime-intersections: Apply the existing per-point shutter lifetime contract to native Gaussian splat primary and shadow intersections before stochastic opacity evaluation; keep the native 5.3 traversal and independent geometry-union packing unchanged.
purposes.0085-temporal-output-sample-count.patch: Report cumulative sample progress across temporal denoising updates while using the current buffer accumulation count for pixel normalization.
purposes.0086-tessellated-motion-normal-stride.pa: Refresh the mesh-union primitive count after tessellation alongside the generic attribute stride so moving authored corner normals use the diced triangle count during true displacement; preserve generic sampled mesh/curve attributes and global geometry offsets.
purposes.0087-volume-object-overlap-broad-phase.p: Bound object-volume overlap flag queries with a conservative spatial broad phase while retaining exact BoundBox::intersects leaf tests, self exclusion, invalid-bound fallback and the existing packed-flag update semantics.
purposes.88: Static triangles must not read motion-normal buffers. Neutral tangent normal maps preserve Blender-equivalent flat, smooth, mixed and custom corner normals on both bases.
purposes.89: Reject missing owner mappings before range uploads and use full-copy fallback for per-device allocations.
purposes.90: Expose current accumulation samples separately from cumulative temporal output progress to correctly recover raw Sample Count.
purposes.91: Read upscaled denoised pixels without filtering through sample counts retained at the lower input resolution; preserve native-resolution and noisy output.
purposes.0092-Upload-OptiX-motion-transforms-with: Fill all OptiX motion transforms in one host buffer and upload them with one copy per top-level build
purposes.0093-Compute-object-bounds-in-parallel.p: Compute object bounds, including motion-blur sampled bounds, in parallel with identical results
purposes.0094-Fill-OptiX-instances-and-motion-tra: Fill OptiX instance descriptions and motion transforms in parallel, keeping OptiX calls on the calling thread
purposes.0095-Keep-object-attribute-tables-when-o: Reuse object attribute requests and packed table contents when every object would store the same attribute values at the same offsets; otherwise rebuild them as before
purposes.0096-Emit-object-attribute-maps-and-offs: Write object attribute map entries and kernel object attribute offsets in parallel with results identical to the serial loops
purposes.0097-Precompute-subdivision-edge-factors: Precompute subdivision edge factors by a speculative parallel split and split faces in order using exactly matching results, identical to the serial split
purposes.0098-Store-subdivision-split-edges-in-an: Look up subdivision split edges in an open addressing table with chunked edge storage, creating and finding the same edges as before
purposes.0099-Fill-OptiX-curve-build-input-in-par: Fill the OptiX curve build input (ribbon bounds, thick and linear curve vertices and indices) in parallel at the serial loop's positions, bitwise identical to the serial fill
purposes.0100-Prepare-object-attribute-tables-in-: Build object attribute requests, layout spans and table values in parallel by prefix sums in object order when objects are added or removed, identical to the per-object conversion; cache attribute ids per range for the attribute map
purposes.0101-Share-the-OptiX-curve-build-input-b: Compute the OptiX curve build input once per multi-device build and upload the same host arrays to every OptiX sub-device; single-device builds unchanged
purposes.0102-Build-OptiX-acceleration-structures: Serialise OptiX acceleration structure builds per device instead of across all devices; CYCLES_OPTIX_GLOBAL_BVH_LOCK restores the shared lock
purposes.0103-Reuse-one-temporary-OptiX-build-buf: Reuse one grow-only temporary OptiX build buffer per device during a geometry update; CYCLES_OPTIX_BVH_TEMP_PER_BUILD restores one allocation per build
purposes.0104-Keep-only-small-OptiX-build-buffers: Keep only temporary OptiX build buffers of at most 64 MB for reuse and release them right after the scene BVH, before the attribute tables are allocated
purposes.0105-Build-the-OptiX-sub-devices-of-one-: Build the OptiX sub-devices of one acceleration structure in parallel; the top level finds its device's bottom level structures through the sub-device index; CYCLES_OPTIX_SERIAL_SUBDEVICE_BVH restores the sequential loop
purposes.0106-Update-only-the-object-table-and-li: Changes of light objects update only the object table, object attribute offsets and lights, not the geometry manager; CYCLES_LIGHT_OBJECT_GEOMETRY_UPDATE restores the previous tagging
purposes.0107-Build-combined-curve-and-point-posi: Build the combined position and radius values of curves and points only when the attribute table copies them; CYCLES_ALWAYS_PACK_POSITION_RADIUS restores the previous packing
purposes.0108-Write-and-copy-only-the-modified-ob: Write and copy only the modified objects of the object table when few objects change and nothing else the table depends on changed; CYCLES_FULL_OBJECT_TABLE_UPDATE restores the full rewrite
purposes.0109-Collect-per-object-kernel-features-: Collect per-object kernel features, the largest primitive count and caustics flags on all cores in fixed blocks combined in order; CYCLES_SERIAL_KERNEL_FEATURES restores the serial loop
purposes.0110-Rewrite-only-the-changed-instances-: Interactive object edits: rewrite only the changed top level instances
purposes.0111-Time-only-tessellation-and-tangents: Profiling: time only tessellation and tangents under their update statistic
purposes.0112-Reuse-the-light-object-list-of-the-: Interactive light edits: no walk over every object to find the lights
purposes.0113-Update-the-flags-of-only-the-writte: Interactive object and light edits: update only the written objects' flags
purposes.0114-Write-only-the-modified-objects-at-: Pose updates of many objects: partial object table at any share, whole-buffer upload for scattered runs
purposes.0115-Keep-the-attribute-tables-when-none: Pose-only edits: keep attribute tables, maps and requests; write only changed objects' values and offsets
purposes.0116-Copy-the-motion-transforms-of-a-sca: Scattered moves of motion blurred instances: whole motion buffer upload instead of one copy per run
purposes.0117-Write-the-values-of-every-object-wi: Correctness of kept attribute tables: write values of every object with attributes
purposes.0118-Record-tracked-device-memory-per-de: Telemetry: per-device whole-update tracked memory and OptiX build temporaries for every scene device update
purposes.0119-Keep-camera-lookup-tables-during-pr: Recompute camera ray matrices for progressive raster changes while retaining authored Image Iris and shutter lookup tables.
purposes.0120-Keep-exact-device-ranges-separate-f: Exact device range transfers with explicit whole-host optimization for complete mirrors
purposes.0121-Reuse-OpenSubdiv-setup-within-a-bou: Retain exact OpenSubdiv topology and patch setup for repeatedly diced IPR meshes under a per-scene memory budget, with live positions and face-varying invalidation.
